name: remenoscodes
description: Claude Code plugins by Emerson Soares — distributed tools, ambient coaching, and developer productivity

plugins.name: claude-language-coach
plugins.description: Ambient language coaching during coding sessions. Learn languages through your daily work with contextual grammar corrections, vocabulary suggestions, false friend alerts, and pronunciation guidance.

plugins.name: claude-git-native-issue
plugins.description: Replace Claude's internal task management with git-native-issue. Autonomous issue creation, tracking, and resolution stored as Git refs. Distributed, offline-first, travels with your code.

plugins.name: claude-statecraft
plugins.description: Disciplined reasoning under uncertainty for Claude. Bundles StateCraft MCP server v2 + 6 skills + 3 commands + hooks + subagents enforcing 4-layer epistemic discipline. Switches LLM from free-form inference to traceable derivations via the StateCraft engine.

plugins.name: claude-systems-thinking
plugins.description: Second epistemic gate: guards invented causal structure. Names the mechanism, the feedback loop, the stock-vs-rate distinction, and the delay before proposing an intervention. Derived from Donella Meadows' System Dynamics lectures.
